fusion_ranked_evidence.title: First Covid-19 vaccine by Bharat Biotech to enter trials in India
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # India’s first Covid-19 vaccine by Bharat Biotech to enter trials. India-based biotechnology company Bharat Biotech has secured regulatory approval from the Drug Controller General of India (DCGI) to advance its Covid-19 vaccine candidate, Covaxin, into human clinical trials. Bharat Biotech’s Covid-19 vaccine is the first domestic vaccine to secure India’s regulatory approval for trials. This marks the first regulatory approval for India’s domestic vaccine to enter trials. In April this year, Bharat Biotech partnered with FluGen and University of Wisconsin–Madison (UWMadison) to develop and evaluate a Covid-19 vaccine candidate, CoroFlu. CoroFlu will be administered intranasally with an aim to induce multiple immune responses. Apart from Bharat Biotech, multiple companies in India are working to develop a Covid-19 vaccine, including Zydus Cadila, Serum Institute of India (SII) and Panacea Biotec. In addition, SII entered a licensing agreement with AstraZeneca for one billion doses of a Covid-19 vaccine developed by the University of Oxford.
